text:
Illus. ryoma uratsuka
◇
It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels
attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

Illus. Saloshi Shira

It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

Illus. Suwama Chiaki
♦ ♦

It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

Illus. Aya Kusubo

It never forgets any attack it endured while in the
cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

Illus. Midori Harada
♦ ♦ ♦

It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust
when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

Illus. Kooki Saitou
♦ ♦

Lilooe clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

Illus. Midori Harada
♦ ♦ ♦

Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

Illus. Sumiyoshi Kizuki

When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

Illus. Aneosaki Dynamic

There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

Illus. Yoriyuki Ikegami
◇
The trio is together from birth. It constantly
gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

Illus. sowsow

It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through
Shelmet's shell. Karrablast doesn't eat the shell—
it eats only the contents.

llus. su
♦

It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karnblast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

Illus. Hasuno
♦ ♦ ♦

Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

Illus. Kyoko Umemoto

After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wallord and drains their life-force.

Illus. Hitoshi Arigo
♦ ♦

One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

Illus. Miki Tanaka
♦

Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

Illus. Tomokazu Komiya
It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

Illus. Naoyo Kimura
♦ ♦ ♦

This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

Illus. Saya Tsuruta

If you've been accepted by Ponyya, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

Illus. Yukiko Baba
♦ ♦

The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it
decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

Illus. AKIRA EGAWA
♦ ♦

It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body
temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees
Fahrenheit.

Illus. Kan Sugimori
♦ ♦ ♦

There are stories of this Pokémon using ics radiant, flame-claked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

Illus. Teeziro

The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

Illus. Naoyo Kimura
♦ ♦

The fur covering this Pokémon's body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

Illus. PLANETA CG Works
♦ ♦ ♦ ♦
exrule When your Pokémon ex is
Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Illus. Kurata So

It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get
the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

Illus. Kooki Saitou

A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

Illus. Mousho

If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit
add powers. It seems unable to recall such an
episode.
